waiver.title: Before you publish: what you're agreeing to
waiver.lead: A 30-second summary in plain language. Nothing is public: only paying schools and families can see your profile, and you can hide or delete it in one click, any time.

contact.title: Contact details, one at a time
contact.i3: Only the ones you choose to add
contact.i4: You can see who viewed them
contact.i5: Members have a daily viewing limit

never.title: We never ask for or store

who.title: Who sees you depends on what you're open to
who.schoolsBody: See you only if you're open to full-time or part-time work. They never see that you tutor, or your rates.
who.familiesBody: See you only if you offer private tutoring or coaching. They never see your school-work wishes.
who.between: Schools and families contact you directly, using only the contact details you chose to share. Any arrangement, such as cover for an absent teacher, is for you and the school to agree between yourselves.

confirm.title: Please confirm each item
confirm.termsPrivacy: I have read the <terms>Terms of use</terms> and <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>.
confirm.publishToMembers: I agree to show my profile to paying schools if I'm open to school work, and to paying families if I offer private tutoring.
confirm.contactOnRequest: I agree that members can see the contact details I add when they ask to view them.
confirm.truthful: My information is true, and I have the right to work or teach in the ways I describe.
confirm.marketing: Send me tips and news about LearningLinks.

side.controlBody: Hide your profile, change what's shown, or delete everything from Settings. Hiding takes one click and takes effect immediately.
side.recordBody: When you agreed, which version, in which language, and the exact wording you saw, so there is clear proof of what you accepted. You can withdraw at any time.

waiver.alreadyAgreed: You agreed to the current waiver. You can review or withdraw it in Settings.

errors.incomplete: Please tick every required item to continue.
errors.server: Something went wrong. Please try again.

profile.title: Build your profile
profile.lead: Takes about 5 minutes. Save a draft at any time. Nothing is shown to anyone until you press Publish.

sections.where: Where and what kind of work

fields.displayNameHint: First name and initial is enough. No numbers, links or contact details.
fields.headline: Headline
fields.headlineHint: One line, for example: Kindergarten English teacher: phonics and storytelling
fields.bioHint: Please don't put phone numbers, emails, links or addresses here. Add contact details under Contact, where members see them only when they ask.
fields.bioBoth: Schools and families both read this text. Write only what you are happy for both to see.
fields.districtsHint: Members see these as areas on the map, never an address.
fields.districtsNone: District choices for this city are coming. Members will find you at city level.
fields.openTo: Open to (this decides who can see you)
fields.tutoringHint: Visible to paying families only. Your hourly rate is shown to families only.
fields.openToHint: Schools never see that you tutor, and families never see that you want school work. Tick nothing in a group and that audience can't see you.
fields.betweenHint: Schools and families contact you directly. Arrangements such as cover for an absent teacher are for you and the school to agree between yourselves.
fields.workAuthHint: Pick a category. Never enter permit or ID numbers. Rules differ by country, and private tutoring may not be allowed on an employer-sponsored permit.
fields.credentialsHint: Link to proof hosted by the issuer, starting with https://. Please don't upload certificates here: we store links, not documents.
fields.contactIntro: Only paying schools and families can see these, and only when they ask. Add the ones you actually check. At least one is needed to publish.
fields.visibilityBody: Your profile is visible only to logged-in paying members. It is never public and never indexed by search engines. You can hide it any time.

photo.label: Photo (optional)
photo.hint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. We resize it and remove location data.
photo.saveFirst: Save your draft first, then you can add a photo.

errors.tooLarge: That file is larger than 5 MB.
errors.notAnImage: That file is not a readable image.
errors.unsupportedType: Please use a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
errors.tooSmall: The image is too small. Use one at least 160 pixels wide and tall.
errors.tooManyPixels: The image is too large to process. Please use a smaller one.
errors.needsProfile: Save your draft first, then add a photo.
errors.rateLimited: Too many uploads. Please try again later.
errors.server: Something went wrong. Please try again.

preview.title: How members will see you
preview.contactLocked: Contact details are shown only when a member asks to see them

tips.headline: Add a headline
tips.bio: Write a short introduction (at least 40 characters)
tips.photo: Add a photo to get more replies
tips.teachingModes: Choose in person, online or both
tips.openTo: Choose what kind of work you are open to

status.label: Status
status.published: Published: visible to the right paying members

actions.unpublishedNow: Saved. Your profile was taken down to draft because something required is now missing. Fix it and publish again.
actions.hideNote: Hide or delete anytime from Settings.

blockers.title: Before you can publish:
blockers.languages: Choose at least one teaching language
blockers.teachingModes: Choose in person, online or both
blockers.openTo: Choose what kind of work you are open to
blockers.contact: Add at least one way to contact you
blockers.suspended: This profile was suspended by LearningLinks and cannot be published.

errors.nameChars: Use letters only: no numbers, links or symbols.
errors.contactInfo: Please remove phone numbers, emails, links and messenger IDs from this text. Add them under Contact instead.
errors.idNumber: This looks like an ID, passport or permit number. We never collect these: please remove it.
errors.address: This looks like a street address. We never collect home addresses: please remove it.
errors.rateOrder: The lowest rate must not be above the highest.
errors.rateRange: Enter a whole number between 1 and 20,000.
errors.invalidPhone: Enter 8 to 15 digits, with an optional + at the start.
errors.invalidLine: A LINE ID uses letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores.
errors.invalidWechat: A WeChat ID starts with a letter and is 6 to 20 characters.
errors.invalidUrl: Use a full link starting with https://
errors.server: Something went wrong. Please try again.

settings.title: Profile settings
settings.lead: You are in control. Everything here takes effect immediately.

visibility.title: Who can see you
visibility.published: Your profile is published. Paying schools and families can see it, each seeing only their side.
visibility.notPublished: Your profile is not shown to anyone right now.

waiver.title: Your agreement
waiver.agreed: You agreed to the current waiver. We keep the exact wording you saw.
waiver.none: You have not agreed to the current waiver.
waiver.withdrawNote: Withdrawing hides your profile at once. You can agree again later.

delete.title: Delete my profile
delete.body: Removes your profile, contact details and photo. Your account stays, and we keep a record that you agreed to the waiver.
delete.confirm: Delete my profile, contact details and photo? This cannot be undone.

account.title: Delete my account
account.body: Deletes your account and everything linked to it, including your profile, contact details, photo and the record of your agreement. This cannot be undone.
account.confirm: Delete your account and everything linked to it? This cannot be undone.

done.withdrawn: Your agreement is withdrawn and your profile is hidden.

home.title: Hello, {name}
home.intro: Educators are free, always. Here is where you are.
home.jobsBody: Schools post full-time and part-time jobs. Only educators with a profile can see them.
home.jobsLocked: Create your profile to see job posts.
